headline: Software slump drags stocks lower
context: Software stocks led a broad sell-off as Anthropic's planned share sale weighed on the sector, while Nvidia's results were due after the close.
chart_title: Every sector fell, utilities the most

FIX.text: No company news. It rose against a falling market; fellow builders Quanta and EMCOR were up too.

COHR.text: Rose after reports that the US will press ahead with limits on imports of Chinese data centre equipment.

CIEN.text: No company news. Optical network stocks rose together, with Lumentum also higher.

CRM.text: Led a renewed software sell-off, its worst day since May 2024, as Anthropic's planned IPO weighed on the sector.

INTU.text: No company news. It fell with other software makers; Salesforce, Workday and FICO all dropped sharply.

NOW.text: No company news. It slid with the wider software sell-off led by Salesforce.
